result.instructions: Tools for Abacus POS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are low on stock at our main location?"; "Find the customer with the email jane@example.com and show their reward points."; "Show our top-selling products for last week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Abacus POS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run abacuspos_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run abacuspos_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run abacuspos_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. abacuspos_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: abacuspos_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products in the POS catalogue. Filter by product id or product codes. Abacus API: GET /products.

productCodes.description: Return only products with these product codes.

lastUpdated.description: Return records changed since this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2017-06-26T00:00:00.00Z (default: all records).

tools.name: abacuspos_list_stock_levels
tools.title: List stock levels
tools.description: List stock levels per product and location, with stock quantity, available quantity and safety stock. Filter by location, product ids or product codes. Abacus API: GET /stocks.

location.description: Return stock for this location name.

productIds.description: Return stock for these product ids.

productCodes.description: Return stock for these product codes.

lastUpdated.description: Return records changed since this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2017-06-26T00:00:00.00Z (default: all records).

tools.name: abacuspos_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the warehouse locations of the store. Abacus API: GET /Locations.

tools.name: abacuspos_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders. Filter by product id, price, discounted flag or last update. Abacus API: GET /purchaseorders.

productId.description: Return orders for this product id.

discounted.description: Filter by whether the price is discounted.

lastUpdated.description: Return records changed since this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2017-06-26T00:00:00.00Z (default: all records).

tools.name: abacuspos_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get a purchase order
tools.description: Get one purchase order by its PO number. Abacus API: GET /purchaseorders/{poNumber}.

productId.description: Limit the lines to this product id.

tools.name: abacuspos_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers. Abacus API: GET /suppliers.

tools.name: abacuspos_list_tax_rates
tools.title: List tax rates
tools.description: List the tax rates configured in the store. Abacus API: GET /TaxRates.

tools.name: abacuspos_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers with member codes, contact details and reward points. Filter by email or mobile (use this to find a customer by mobile number), or by last update. Abacus API: GET /customers.

mobile.description: Return customers with this mobile number.

lastUpdated.description: Return records changed since this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2017-06-26T00:00:00.00Z (default: all records).

tools.name: abacuspos_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by member code, with contact details, membership and reward points. Abacus API: GET /customers/{memberCode}.

tools.name: abacuspos_find_customer_by_email
tools.title: Find a customer by email
tools.description: Find one customer by email address. An email with a plus sign is not accepted in this path: use abacuspos_list_customers with email instead. Abacus API: GET /customers/GetByEmail/{email}.

tools.name: abacuspos_list_memberships
tools.title: List memberships
tools.description: List the membership plans of the store. Abacus API: GET /memberships.

tools.name: abacuspos_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices. Filter by product, created date, price, discount, deleted flag or customer link. Abacus API: GET /invoices.

productId.description: Return invoices with this product id.

createdTo.description: Return invoices created up to this ISO 8601 time.

discounted.description: Filter by whether the invoice was discounted.

hasCustomer.description: Filter by whether a customer is linked.

lastUpdated.description: Return records changed since this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2017-06-26T00:00:00.00Z (default: all records).

tools.name: abacuspos_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by its invoice number. Abacus API: GET /invoices/{invoiceNumber}.

productId.description: Limit the lines to this product id.

tools.name: abacuspos_get_order_status
tools.title: Get an order status
tools.description: Get the status of one online order by its order reference. Abacus API: GET /orders/{orderReference}.

orderReference.description: The order reference returned when the order was created.

tools.name: abacuspos_list_top_selling_products
tools.title: List top-selling products
tools.description: Report the products sold in a time range, ranked by sales. Abacus API: GET /report/TopSellingReport.

startTime.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00.00Z.

endTime.description: End of the range, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-30T23:59:59.00Z.

tools.name: abacuspos_list_cash_registers
tools.title: List cash registers
tools.description: List cash register sessions in a time range, with opening and closing amounts. Abacus API: GET /registers.

tools.name: abacuspos_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List staff members. Abacus API: GET /staffs.

lastUpdated.description: Return records changed since this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2017-06-26T00:00:00.00Z (default: all records).

tools.name: abacuspos_get_store_info
tools.title: Get store info
tools.description: Get the store's details: company name, address, phone, status, preparation time and operating hours. The login key check uses this call. Abacus API: GET /store/operationInfo.

tools.name: abacuspos_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer with name and email, and optional contact details, membership and tags. Tags are created if missing. Abacus API: POST /customers.

memberCode.description: Member code to assign. Leave empty to let Abacus assign one.

tools.name: abacuspos_add_customer_points
tools.title: Add reward points
tools.description: Add reward points to a customer's balance, with an optional reference note. Changes the customer's balance. Abacus API: PUT /customers/{memberCode}/addpoints.

point.description: Number of reward points to add.

reference.description: Note stored with the points transaction.

prompts.description: Rank the products sold in a time range by sales. Look up the catalogue entries of the top products.

prompts.name: trace_an_online_order_and_look_up_a_sales_invoice
prompts.title: Trace an online order and look up a sales invoice
prompts.description: Check the status of an online order by its reference. Open a sales invoice by its number to check the sale.

prompts.name: create_a_customer_and_add_reward_points
prompts.title: Create a customer and add reward points
prompts.description: Create the customer with a name and email. Then add reward points with a reference note. Both steps change the store data.
